evidence.source_sentence: A mixture of the PerInit 6 (46.9 mg, 0.05 mmol), the nitroxide 7 (2.5 mmol as a stock solution from o-dichlorobenzene) and 4-vinyltriphenylamine (678 mg, 2.5 mmol) in 100 mL odichlorobenzene was degassed by three freeze-pump-thaw cycles, sealed under argon, and heated at 125 8C for 30 and 60 min for 8a and 8b respectively.
